//: Workspace root. Each package carries its own tsconfig and is checked by its own
`check` script — `astro check` for web, because plain tsc cannot resolve .astro
imports, and tsc for core and api.
This config covers only the loose files at the repository root, which no
package config includes. It deliberately does NOT use project references:
those require `composite: true` on every referenced config, and a composite
build cannot typecheck the web package anyway.
